world.note: OSM boundary w285375235 bbox (x 428062-428893, y 5105659-5106596: 831 x 938 m) + about 120 m each side, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (about 220 m of scenery east-west, 170 m north-south); inside the downloaded rasters (x 427800-429400, y 5105200-5107000)

scorecard_source: stymie.golf (Astoria Golf & Country Club page, read 2026-10-24): per-hole yards, par and stroke index for every set, men's ratings and slopes; every row adds up to its totals. Unverified (third party). Cross-checked: GSPro course card in the astoria-data release (its 'Blue' 6,298 is the Silver set within 2 yd on 16 holes; hole 12 456 vs 471), GolfPass (Silver 6,331, ratings 70.7/121), opengolfapi (Tournament only, par 71, other stroke index). See docs/courses/astoria.md.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Imagery check: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): no Blue set, so Silver (6,321, closest to 6,300); all water red; OB = the OSM boundary; wind 3-14 mph (open coast); theme astoria (new, course chat's own, as the brief allowed): rough drawn tawny with a 2 m mown band beside the fairways, as the summer 2024 photo shows. Name shown in the game: "Astoria Country Club" (developer 2026-10-24; the club is Astoria Golf & Country Club).

trees_need_ortho.note: the DOGAMI lidar here is the 2008-09 North Coast flight; lidar crowns that are not dark canopy on the OSIP 2024 photo are dropped (pipeline/gorse.py missing_in_ortho), as at Gearhart 8 km south (737 gone there)

green_tilt.note: the 3rd's small green (210 m2, 25 x 11 m) at the end of the narrow valley: tilt capped at 2 % (fitted 3.2 %) and no random undulations, so the game finds three pin positions on it under 3 % (pins.test.ts)
the 16th's small green (272 m2): no random undulations (they reached 5.1 %), so the game finds three pin positions on it (pins.test.ts)
